title: Tableau tape sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\tau$ be a tape of $M$. If the previous visit time of tape $\tau$ before time $t$ is undefined, the source list has $\operatorname{snapWidth}(M)+1$ copies of the constant vertex for $n$ with value false. If that previous visit time is $s$, the source list consists of the constant vertex for $n$ with value true, followed by the tableau block for $M,n,s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
